rev6.release_notes: A program posted again while you are editing it opens in a tab of its own, marked new; your edits stay in the other tab, and saving that one asks before going over the newer file. Simulate: a center drill in the tool list and keywords, drawn as a real center drill; cutters 2 inches and larger drawn as face mills; switching the stock to Round puts its origin at the center.

cadcam.release_notes: Program It: a turning program from the part in one click, with a review panel. Sketch on a diameter (a plane tangent to a round face). Pattern along a path. Center drills and custom mill tools in Tools, drawn in Simulate; cutters 2 inches and larger drawn as face mills. The Speed and Feed Database first in the list. Lathe Drill / Tap cycle.
